# Addresses reference

Every method of the addresses resources and every object they return. Types link to their section; objects used by several areas are in [shared objects](shared.md).

The objects each method returns, and the objects inside them. An object is expanded the first time it appears.

- `find()`: [`Address`](shared.md#address)
  - `location()`: `?`[`Location`](shared.md#location)

  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)

- `reverse()`: [`ReverseResults`](shared.md#reverseresults)`<`[`ReverseAddress`](#reverseaddress)`>`

    - `province()`: `?`[`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
    - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)

## Methods

<a name="addresses-methods"></a>
### `Addresses`

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `withLocator(Locator $locator)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the home or area of the locator. |
| `find(bool $includeRd = false)` | [`Address`](shared.md#address) | Address validation |
| `findAll(bool $includeRd = false)` | [`Results`](shared.md#results)`<`[`Address`](shared.md#address)`>` | Every home at the postcode and house number |
| `suggest(string $query, ?int $limit = null, list<SuggestionType\|string> $types = [])` | [`Results`](shared.md#results)`<`[`AddressSuggestion`](#addresssuggestion)`>` | Address autocomplete |
| `reverse(string\|float $latitude, string\|float $longitude, ?int $radiusInMeters = null, ?int $limit = null)` | [`ReverseResults`](shared.md#reverseresults)`<`[`ReverseAddress`](#reverseaddress)`>` | Reverse geocoding |
| `withMaxCacheAge(int $seconds)` | `static` | Returns a copy that keeps answers at most this many seconds in the cache. |
| `withoutCache()` | `static` | Returns a copy that neither reads nor writes the cache. |
| `withBagId(string $bagId)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the home with the BAG id. |
| `withPostcode(string $postcode, int $houseNumber, ?string $extension = null)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the home at the postcode, house number and extension. |
